headline: Does giving a camera wings dodge the FCC’s drone ban?
summary: HoverAir is attempting to bypass a US drone ban with a new camera design. The US government banned future foreign drones starting December 2025. This new HoverAir drone features unique gimmicks like folding flat and landing on water.

headline: Nielsen is leaning more on wearables to hear what people are watching
summary: Nielsen will now use data from wearable devices to measure viewership. This aims to improve accuracy for streaming era data. New enhancements are being added to their data capturing process.

headline: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
summary: Google Gemini is launching a new dedicated student hub. The hub offers tools for research, flashcards, and practice quizzes. Study notebooks will support graphs, images, and test date integration.

headline: Watch Valve set up the Steam Frame in its own leaked videos
summary: Valve accidentally leaked videos of its Steam Frame VR headset. The leaked content showed unboxing, setup, and accessories. The Steam Frame is Valve's VR headset designed for streaming games.

headline: Ryan Reynolds Congratulates Christopher Nolan's the Odyssey for Surpassing Deadpool & Wolverine to Become Highest Grossing R-Rated Movie of All Time
summary: Ryan Reynolds congratulated Christopher Nolan on "The Odyssey" success. "The Odyssey" surpassed "Deadpool & Wolverine" as the highest-grossing R-rated film. Both films have held the title of highest-grossing R-rated movie.

headline: Save $75 Off the Nintendo Switch 2 Plus Up to $130 in Best Buy Credit When You Trade in a Switch Console
summary: Save $75 on the Nintendo Switch 2 at Best Buy. Get up to $130 in Best Buy credit for trading in a Switch console. Total savings can reach $205 before the September 1 price hike.

headline: Mail-Order Media Giant Columbia House Shutting Down After 71 Years
summary: Columbia House, the mail-order media giant, is shutting down. The company ceases new orders after 71 years of business. It was known for its mail-order music and movie club.

headline: Preorder SPECS, Snap's First-Ever AR Glasses
summary: Snap has unveiled its first-ever AR glasses, called SPECS. SPECS are described as a lightweight and stylish wearable computer. Pre-orders are now available for Snap's new augmented reality device.

headline: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are reportedly moving back to the UK. Their children, Archie and Lilibet, are enrolled in a UK school. The children are expected to start school in September.

headline: Couple and teenage daughter who died in water off Shoreham named by police
summary: Police have named a family who tragically died in the sea off Shoreham. A couple and their teenage daughter were among the victims. The family traveled from London and entered the sea for a swim.

headline: People smuggler exposed by BBC investigation arrested and charged
summary: A people smuggler, Twana Jamal Khdir, has been arrested. Khdir was exposed following a BBC investigation. He has been charged with immigration offences.

headline: Vaccine breakthrough stops cancer returning in trial
summary: A new vaccine has shown promise in preventing cancer recurrence. Trial results indicate it extended patients' cancer-free periods. The duration of the vaccine's effectiveness is still being determined.
